paper_title: Weak nuclear decays deep-underground as a probe of axion dark matter
notes: Constraint on axion coupling to gluons (theta-term), reported as 1/f_a vs m_a in the CP-violating/EDM-type convention where m_a f_a = (76 MeV)^2 (Eq 4.2). Headline curve is the 40K EC-decay recast (Fig.3 yellow region, most sensitive of the two experiments; 137Cs beta-decay line lies ~11x higher). Derived from Eq.(4.5) amplitude with the excluded modulation amplitude 6.8e-6 (2sigma) and Ghat/G=18.8 (Eq 4.13); reproduces the text-quoted exclusion f_a < 1.0e14 - 3.2e10 GeV over m_a = 3.0e-23 - 9.6e-20 eV. The boundary is a power law 1/f_a proportional to m_a (log-log slope 1); two endpoints suffice, extra points interpolated on the line. rho_DM=0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed (Eq 4.1). CL=2sigma. Future 40K measurement (cross-hatched) is a projection and excluded.
